includingCensored.note: ok samples plus censored samples; each censored value is the elapsed time at the end of the run and is a lower bound on the true wait

phaseSumConsistency.definition: job.phase-residual = pool.compute-metric - (prepare + slowest worker path + merge tail); a signed value in ms, reported as measured and never forced to zero

jobDecomposition.units: microseconds, except reportedMetric which is in the job's own unit (milliseconds)

methods: worker thread, task containing the receive time
workerMatching.note: worker thread known from its clock marks; the task is the one containing the worker's receive time, else the largest task in the job window

counts.note: counts only; the levels are rows of a report table (reported metric at or above the level, in ms), not budgets or thresholds

jobLevelDecomposition.units: microseconds, except reportedMetric (milliseconds) and the count lateStartWorkers
jobLevelDecomposition.window: first post to the start of the last reply handler on main; worker tasks are top-level tasks on DedicatedWorker threads that start at or after the first post
